correctness.rationale: Every inclusion-minimal edge cover is a spanning star forest since each edge must have a degree-one endpoint. With a,b>=2, any cover has >=2 components and size<=a+b−2. A hypothetical shattered support of this maximal size must equal a two-star minimal cover; deleting an appropriate leaf edge while keeping all others forces a redundant retained edge (with separate a=2 or b=2 case), impossible. For a=2 the support of b−1 edges all incident to one vertex realizes every trace by assigning free right vertices. For a,b>=3 the three-star support {(0,j):j>=2} U {(i,0):i>=2} U {(1,1)} has a constructive extension to a minimal cover for every trace using the two cases depending on the middle edge. Independently brute enumerated minimal covers, all shattering candidates and VCdim for (2,2),(2,3),(3,3),(3,4), obtaining a+b−3 in each. For min(a,b)=1 the sole cover is the entire star and VCdim=0.
